fact: The updated Sénégal Numérique 2025 action plan (2020-2025) is costed at 1,106.46 billion FCFA with 74 actions across 3 prerequisites and 4 axes, governed by a National Digital Council and a steering committee, and states 19% implementation of the strategy at the 2019 review.
title: Stratégie Sénégal Numérique 2025 (SN2025) Plan d'actions actualisé
